resources.string: Stored locally for up to 7 days, limited to 10 MB. No automatic uploads. Native crashes, ANRs and system kills are not captured.
Credentials, full URLs and file paths are filtered. Server hosts and media titles or identifiers may remain.
Collection is off. Existing logs remain available until cleared or expired.
%1$d matches in the latest 500 entries. Export includes all retained logs, without search or level filters.
Delete all locally stored logs and temporary exports? New events may appear while collection is on. Files already saved or shared outside the app cannot be deleted here.
Export all retained logs? Credentials and paths are filtered, but server hosts and media information may remain. Only share logs with people you trust.
Unable to complete the log operation. Check available storage or try another app.
Unable to read or write diagnostic logs. Check available storage.
